note: Roadmap is indicative, not a commitment — priorities can shift.

items.title: Additional database backends
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.13. Run EVE Console on PostgreSQL instead of the built-in SQLite file, with an in-app test-and-copy that migrates an existing database across — and several clients sharing one server.

items.title: Native Linux support
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.13. First-class, self-updating Linux builds — an AppImage or a tarball — ship alongside the Windows builds with every release.

items.title: Standalone background service
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.13. The ESI polling, importing and alarm work can run headless — on another machine or in a container — as a systemd user unit or Windows service, independent of the desktop client.

items.title: Web-based storefront
items.note: Delivered in 0.9.14. A public web storefront for your in-app store, hosted on your own Cloudflare account: buyers sign in with EVE SSO, browse your price list, and place orders that flow straight into the app.

items.title: Improved Embedded Agent Abilities
items.note: Give the built-in AI agent more EVE and application context, plus an assortment of in-app tools so it can take on tasks you'd otherwise do by hand.

items.title: Alarms
items.note: Complete the alarms system introduced in 0.9.10 — a fuller set of conditions to watch for and ways to be notified.

items.title: Ship fitting tool
items.note: Build and assess ship fits inside EVE Console — slots, modules and charges — drawing on the item, market and skill data it already holds.

items.title: Planetary Interaction tools
items.note: Tools for Planetary Interaction: track your colonies and extractors, plan production, and fold PI chores like restarting extractors and hauling into the Worklist.
